title: Singingcrow v. Brown (A187237)
text:
ORDER OF SUMMARY AFFIRMANCE
Appellate Court Administrator, Appellate Court Records Section
1163 State Street, Salem, Oregon 97301-2563
Page 1 of 1
IN THE COURT OF APPEALS OF THE STATE OF OREGON
Stella Ann Singingcrow,
Petitioner-Appellant,
v.
Nichole Brown, Superintendent, Coffee Creek Correctional Institution,
Defendant-Respondent.
Washington County Circuit Court No. 24CV42688
Court of Appeals No. A187237
ORDER OF SUMMARY AFFIRMANCE
Before Egan, Presiding Judge, and Joyce, Judge.
Respondent (the superintendent) moves pursuant to ORS 138.660 for summary
affirmance on the ground that the appeal does not present a substantial question of law.
Petitioner opposes the motion.
The court determines that, for the reasons stated in the superintendent’s motion,
even assuming that the principles articulated in State v. Bartol, 368 Or 598, 496 P3d
1013 (2021) apply to this case, petitioner’s brief does not present a substantial question
of law regarding whether the post-conviction court erred in denying post-conviction
relief. Therefore, the motion is granted.
Affirmed.
James C. Egan
Presiding Judge
6/15/2026
DESIGNATION OF PREVAILING PARTY AND AWARD OF COSTS
Prevailing party: Respondent Costs: No costs allowed
